riferimento: Schymanski et al., Environ. Sci. Technol. 2014, 48, 2097
scala: Schymanski scale, label «L» + level (L2a, L3b); the prediction scale of Löffler et al. (ES&T 59:19095, 2025) is another one, label «Prev. N»

punti.riferimento: stepped points per proof after Alygizakis et al., TrAC 2023, as an explanation and never as a learned model: the total orders the candidates, the level stays the cascade above (2b and 1 only by the chemist). A proof 'against' earns no points and is never offset. Steps are listed best first; a string is the key of a threshold of 'soglie'.

attributio.fonte: attributio 1.12.0 (commit 2bde634), annotate.py: AnnotationSettings, LEVEL_BASIS_LABEL, level_reasons; only thresholds, rules and wording

cascata.regola: user standard: mass + RT + MS/MS (cosine with the spectrum of the standard of the SAME ion)
at least one valid EXPERIMENTAL library source (mzCloud, MassBank, MoNA): cosine >= coseno_min AND shared ions >= ioni_comuni_min AND precursor within precursore_ppm_max (beyond = analogue, never 2a)

ONLY by decision of the chemist, never automatic (the programme may propose, not assign): probable structure from diagnostic fragments and in-silico spectra (MetFrag, CFM-ID, SIRIUS/CSI:FingerID) or an unambiguous chemical context without a standard in the library; from 2a, 3a, 3b or 4, refused on 5 and 0 with a warning; the RT rule wins over 2b
valid sources that name different structures (first InChIKey block) and the best ahead by less than margine_conflitto_coseno
the same library compound at two or more RT (beyond rt_gruppo_tol_min)
the user standard elutes at another RT: another isomer
the chemist judges a 2a match insufficient
OFF by default (putative_library_level3): a library entry named 'Spectral Match to ...' or propagated, that passes the gates of a source

CSI:FingerID structure with COSMIC (ConfidenceScoreApproximate) >= cosmic_min (0.64 is roughly 10% FDR for the paper's confidence score, a guide with no guarantee; applied here to the Approximate score, Hoffmann et al. 2022); never downgrades a library match
CANOPUS class only (NPClassifier pathway or ClassyFire superclass) with probability >= canopus_prob_min
standard found by mass + RT but MS/MS not confirmed: outside the counts

fonti_escluse: propagated GNPS2 annotations (name starting with 'Candidate', or containing '(known structural isomers' or '(delta mass:'): never a source
mzMine lipids with method = 'matchedlipid': not spectral matches

structure (SMILES/InChI/InChIKey/formula) of the mzMine library: used only if the formula explains the precursor of the entry within struttura_libreria_ppm_max with the declared adduct or a common one (known bug of mzMine exports: reused keys)

testi_basi_en.reference standard: Confirmed by reference standard: mass + RT + MS/MS (L1)
testi_basi_en.diagnostic evidence: Structure supported by diagnostic fragments, in-silico spectra or an unambiguous chemical context, judged by the chemist (L2b)
testi_basi_en.name conflict: Spectral library matches of different structures that the spectrum does not tell apart (best match ahead by less than the margin): named by the best match (L3a)
testi_basi_en.isomers not discriminated: Spectral library match of the same compound at two or more retention times: the spectrum does not tell the isomers apart (L3a)
testi_basi_en.RT isomer: Spectral library match at a retention time other than the reference standard's: another isomer (L3a)
testi_basi_en.expert review: Spectral library match judged insufficient by the chemist (L3a)
testi_basi_en.suspect-RT: Reference standard, mass + RT only, MS/MS not confirmed (suspect-RT, L0)

lr.fonte: unit resolution (triple quadrupole, nominal masses): never above 4 (an MS2 does not raise a level, decision D6 of Tabui), a nominal mass is a candidate and not an identification; 4 when the nominal formula alone explains the ion; 5 otherwise
